system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.music: A restrained low synth drone with a soft metallic shimmer, held quietly under the scene and never rising above the engine.
fragments.shot:shot-1:description: A concrete road tunnel stretches away into unlit depth, its walls pale grey and faintly damp, two long rows of sodium strip lights burning overhead and fading toward the far end. <Subject:subject-3> rests at the very back of that darkness, only a thin rim of light tracing the roof line of its carbon-fibre body. <Subject:subject-2> stands clear of the near lane with his weight settled on one hip, and <Subject:subject-1> stays visible further back inside the bay, the red jacket bright against the shadowed concrete. Dust hangs in the beams, and the floor is scuffed with old tyre marks and shallow puddles that hold thin vertical reflections of the lights.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: For the first moments the frame is mostly darkness and the bare geometry of the tunnel; the strips overhead burn a dull amber haze, and the far bay where <Subject:subject-3> waits is almost black, its panels giving back only a wet-looking glint along the flank.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: Low tunnel room tone with a faint idle carrying from the far bay and a thin drip of water on concrete.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: <Subject:subject-3> rolls forward out of the dark, wheels turning slowly over the scuffed floor, headlights still dead so the body reads as a darker mass pressing against the amber haze.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: As it advances, the leading edge of the <Subject:subject-3> eases into the overhead sodium light; highlights slide along the carbon-fibre panels, the windscreen takes a flat amber sheen, and the car grows steadily larger in the frame while the light behind it stays unbroken.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:4: <Subject:subject-2> shifts his stance and turns to track the car as it passes into the light, one hand loose at his side, his grey overall picking up a warmer edge from the strips above.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:5: The engine lifts to a low, even rev and the tyre roll thickens across the concrete as the car keeps coming toward the near lane.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:6: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: Tunnel room tone with a distant engine idle settling into a low, even rev, and dry tyre roll on scuffed concrete.
